summary: Completed comprehensive Phase 3 testing of OpenClaw Command Center. Backend: 100% pass rate (38/38 tests including 5 new Phase 3 endpoints). Frontend: All Phase 3 features tested and working - Deliberation Room, Memory Graph, Notification Center, Settings (Provider Config & System Health), and Sidebar features all functional. UI overlay issue persists from Phase 1 requiring force clicks.

ui_bugs.issue: HTML element intercepts pointer events on interactive buttons (Memory nav, Notification bell, Settings nav, etc.)
ui_bugs.selector: Various buttons blocked by <html> element overlay
ui_bugs.workaround: Use force=True in Playwright clicks to bypass overlay
ui_bugs.impact: All buttons are functional but require force clicks in automated tests. Likely caused by 'Made with Emergent' badge or similar overlay element.

action_item_for_main_agent: Fix UI overlay issue: The HTML element or 'Made with Emergent' badge is intercepting pointer events on interactive buttons throughout the app. This requires force clicks in automated tests. Recommend adding pointer-events: none to overlay elements or adjusting z-index to prevent interference with interactive UI elements. This is a carryover issue from Phase 1 testing.
